items.question: What is artificial intelligence (AI)?
items.answer: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is the branch of computer science dedicated to developing software systems capable of performing tasks that typically require human cognition, such as reasoning, problem-solving, visual perception, and decision-making.

items.question: What is machine learning (ML)?
items.answer: Machine learning is a subset of AI where mathematical algorithms learn statistical patterns from historical data to make predictions or automated decisions without being explicitly programmed.

items.question: What is ChatGPT?
items.answer: ChatGPT is an artificial intelligence conversational model developed by OpenAI. Built on Large Language Models (LLMs), it engages in natural dialogue, writes and debugs code, and synthesizes complex information.

items.question: What is cloud computing?
items.answer: Cloud computing delivers on-demand computing services—including virtual servers, database storage, networking, and software—over the Internet with flexible pay-as-you-go pricing (e.g., AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud).

items.question: What is cybersecurity?
items.answer: Cybersecurity is the practice of protecting computer systems, cloud networks, digital devices, and sensitive organizational data from unauthorized access, cyberattacks, theft, and damage.

items.question: What is the Internet of Things (IoT)?
items.answer: The Internet of Things (IoT) refers to an interconnected network of physical devices embedded with sensors, microcontrollers, and wireless connectivity that autonomously collect and exchange operational data in real time.

items.question: What is blockchain technology?
items.answer: Blockchain is a decentralized, cryptographically secured distributed digital ledger that chronologically records transactions across a peer-to-peer network, ensuring tamper-proof immutability without requiring a central intermediary.

items.question: What is data science?
items.answer: Data science is an interdisciplinary field combining statistics, advanced mathematics, domain expertise, and machine learning programming to discover actionable patterns and predictive insights from structured and unstructured data.

items.question: What is quantum computing?
items.answer: Quantum computing harnesses fundamental principles of quantum mechanics—such as superposition and quantum entanglement—to solve specialized mathematical and optimization problems exponentially faster than classical supercomputers.

items.question: What is digital transformation?
items.answer: Digital transformation is the strategic integration of modern digital technology across all operational areas of an organization, fundamentally modernizing operational efficiency and customer value delivery.

items.question: What is Python?
items.answer: Python is a high-level, interpreted programming language known for its concise syntax and dynamic typing. It is widely used across backend web development, data science, scientific computing, automation, and artificial intelligence.

items.question: What is Java and how does it achieve portability?
items.answer: Java is an object-oriented, class-based language built on the 'Write Once, Run Anywhere' (WORA) philosophy. Compiled Java bytecode executes within a Java Virtual Machine (JVM), ensuring seamless cross-platform execution.

items.question: What is C++ and where is it primarily used?
items.answer: C++ is a high-performance compiled language that combines low-level memory control with object-oriented abstractions. It is the industry standard for game engines, operating system components, embedded firmware, and low-latency financial systems.

items.question: What is the difference between HTML and CSS?
items.answer: HTML (HyperText Markup Language) constructs the structural content and semantic hierarchy of a webpage, whereas CSS (Cascading Style Sheets) specifies visual presentation, layout styling, typography, colors, and responsive animations.

items.question: What is JavaScript and Node.js?
items.answer: JavaScript is a dynamic, lightweight scripting language that powers interactive frontend user experiences. With Node.js, JavaScript executes server-side, enabling unified full-stack web application development.

items.question: What is Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and its core pillars?
items.answer: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) is a software design paradigm structured around reusable classes and stateful objects, governed by four core pillars: Encapsulation, Abstraction, Inheritance, and Polymorphism.

items.question: What is the difference between a class and an object?
items.answer: A class is an abstract architectural blueprint defining member properties and methods, while an object is a concrete, self-contained instance instantiated in memory holding actual state data.

items.question: What is an Application Programming Interface (API) and REST?
items.answer: An API is a defined set of communication protocols enabling independent software applications to interact. A REST API leverages standard HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) and stateless JSON data exchange.

items.question: What is Git and how does GitHub complement it?
items.answer: Git is a distributed command-line version control system that tracks source code revisions locally, while GitHub is a cloud platform that hosts remote Git repositories, facilitating pull requests, code reviews, and team collaboration.

items.question: What is Docker and containerization?
items.answer: Docker packages applications and their exact runtime dependencies into lightweight, isolated containers, guaranteeing consistent execution across local development, staging servers, and cloud production environments.

items.question: What is a Database Management System (DBMS)?
items.answer: A DBMS is system software that manages structured data storage, retrieval, and concurrency while enforcing ACID transaction properties (Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, Durability).

items.question: What is the difference between a primary key and a foreign key?
items.answer: A primary key uniquely identifies each individual row within its own table (strictly non-null and unique), whereas a foreign key references a primary key in another table to establish referential relationships.

items.question: What is database normalization and why is it important?
items.answer: Normalization is the systematic design process of structuring database tables (from 1NF to BCNF) to eliminate redundant data duplication and prevent insertion, update, and deletion anomalies.

items.question: What is CRUD in database applications?
items.answer: CRUD is an industry acronym for Create, Read, Update, and Delete—the four foundational operations implemented across persistent database storage and RESTful software APIs.

items.question: What is an Operating System (OS)?
items.answer: An operating system is fundamental system software that coordinates computer hardware, allocates CPU processing time, manages RAM memory and storage I/O, and provides an execution platform for user applications.

items.question: What is binary search algorithm?
items.answer: Binary search is an efficient O(log n) divide-and-conquer algorithm that locates a target value in a sorted collection by repeatedly halving the search interval.

items.question: What is an IP address?
items.answer: An IP address (IPv4/IPv6) is a unique numerical network identifier assigned to every hardware device connected to an IP-based computer network for routing packets.

items.question: What degree programs and engineering branches are offered at SOET MGM University?
items.answer: SOET MGM University offers: 1) UG 4-Year B.Tech Programs after HSC (CSE with IoT/Cyber/Blockchain, CSE Cyber Security, Electronics Engineering VLSI Design & Technology, Robotics and Automation, Electrical Engineering), 2) UG 6-Year B.Tech Integrated Programs after SSC (CSE IoT/Cyber/Blockchain, CSE Data Science, Robotics and AI, Civil Engineering), 3) Direct Second Year Lateral Entry, and 4) Diploma Programs (Diploma in Fire Service & Engineering, Advanced Diploma in Industrial Safety).

items.question: What is the 6-Year Integrated B.Tech program after Class 10 (SSC)?
items.answer: The Integrated 6-Year B.Tech program allows Class 10 (SSC) passed students to start their engineering journey immediately, offering an early advantage with polytechnic fundamentals seamlessly flowing into advanced B.Tech specializations in CSE (IoT/Cyber/Blockchain), CSE (Data Science), Robotics & AI, and Civil Engineering.

items.question: What are the core courses in B.Tech CSE (IoT, Cyber Security & Blockchain)?
items.answer: Core courses include: Embedded systems and IoT device programming, Cybersecurity fundamentals (cryptography, network security, ethical hacking), Blockchain principles (decentralized systems, smart contracts), Hands-on with IoT platforms like Raspberry Pi, and real-world applications in smart cities, healthcare, and Industry 4.0.

items.question: What are the core courses and careers in Electronics Engineering (VLSI Design & Technology)?
items.answer: Core courses cover HDL design (Verilog/VHDL), semiconductor device physics, Cadence/Synopsys/Xilinx EDA tools, low power chip design, and cleanroom labs. Career opportunities include VLSI Design Engineer, ASIC/FPGA Developer, Semiconductor Fabrication Engineer, and chip designers at Intel, Qualcomm, AMD, and TSMC.

items.question: What are the diploma programs available at SOET?
items.answer: SOET offers a 2-Year Diploma in Fire Service and Engineering and a 1-Year Advanced Diploma in Industrial Safety, focusing on firefighting science, disaster management, OSHA/ISO compliance, and industrial risk assessment.

items.question: What teaching methodologies are adopted at SOET?
items.answer: SOET follows an NEP 2020 Aligned Curriculum with Outcome Based Education (OBE). Teaching is Project-Based (PBL), Experiential, and backed by research and collaborative methods.

items.question: What are the 6 steps of the admission procedure at SOET MGM University?
items.answer: The official 6-Step Admission Procedure: Step 01: Fill Application on admissions.mgmu.ac.in. Step 02: Appear for MGMU CET. Step 03: Check Merit List Displayed on Dashboard. Step 04: Verification & Submission of Documents. Step 05: Processing of Fees. Step 06: Admission Successfully Processed.

items.question: What are the eligibility requirements for 4-Year B.Tech programs (after HSC)?
items.answer: Candidates must have passed HSC (12th) with Physics and Mathematics, securing minimum 45% aggregate (40% for reserved category) and appeared in JEE(Mains), MHT-CET, PERA-CET, or MGMU-CET with a non-zero score.

items.question: What are the eligibility requirements for 6-Year Integrated B.Tech (after SSC)?
items.answer: Candidates must have passed SSC (Class 10) with minimum 50% aggregate (45% for reserved category) and have a valid score in MGMU-CET.

items.question: What is the eligibility for Direct 2nd Year (Lateral Entry)?
items.answer: For 4-Year B.Tech Lateral Entry: Direct Second Year after Diploma Course in Engineering & Technology, B.Sc. Degree, or D. Voc. For 6-Year Integrated B.Tech Lateral Entry: Direct Second Year after HSC Passed.

items.question: What is the annual tuition fee structure for B.Tech programs?
items.answer: Annual tuition fees are: ₹150,000/year for B.Tech CSE, AIML, and Cyber Security; ₹140,000/year for ECE; and ₹130,000/year for Mechanical and Civil Engineering.

items.question: What are the fees for the Integrated B.Tech and M.Tech programs?
items.answer: The Integrated 6-Year B.Tech Program is priced at ₹110,000/year, and the M.Tech in CSE is priced at ₹100,000/year.

items.question: What scholarships and financial assistance are available?
items.answer: Government of Maharashtra scholarships (SC, ST, OBC, VJNT, EBC, SEBC) are supported via the MahaDBT portal. Additionally, MGM University awards institutional merit-based scholarships to high-performing students.

items.question: How can tuition fees be paid?
items.answer: Tuition fees can be paid online via Net Banking, Debit/Credit Card, or UPI on the student ERP portal, or offline via Demand Draft (DD) favoring 'MGM University SOET' at the campus accounts counter.

items.question: Who leads SOET MGM University?
items.answer: SOET MGM University is led by Dr. Parminder Kaur Dhingra, Dean & Director. Under her leadership, the institution focuses on industry-aligned curricula, accredited research labs, and top-tier student placements.

items.question: Who are the Department Heads (HODs) at SOET?
items.answer: The Computer Science & Engineering Department is headed by Dr. Sharad S. Gore, and the Mechanical Engineering Department is headed by Mr. Siddiqui Javed A.

items.question: What are the qualifications and experience of the teaching faculty?
items.answer: Faculty members hold post-graduate (M.Tech/M.E.) and doctoral (Ph.D.) degrees with an average academic and research experience of 8 to 20+ years in emerging technological domains.

items.question: Which faculty members teach computer programming and AI?
items.answer: Mrs. Deshmukh Rupali R. (M.Tech, specializing in Python & Image Processing) and Ms. Bhagat Chetana B. (M.Tech, specializing in Software Engineering & Java) guide computer programming and software development.

items.question: Where can students and parents view complete faculty profiles?
items.answer: The comprehensive faculty directory—including contact emails, designations, and research publications—is published online on this website at /faculty.php.

items.question: What are the placement salary packages and statistics at SOET?
items.answer: SOET graduates secure top placement packages up to ₹18.5 LPA, with an average package of ₹5.5 LPA and an 85%+ overall placement rate across engineering disciplines.

items.question: Which prime recruiters hire students from SOET MGM University?
items.answer: Prime recruiters include: Endress+Hauser, TATA Consultancy Services (TCS), IBM, Tech Mahindra, Deloitte, Cognizant, LIEBHERR, Infosys, Škoda Auto, Adobe, BOSCH, Atlas Copco, Wipro, Reliance Jio, and IFB.

items.question: What industry collaborations and MoUs does SOET have?
items.answer: SOET has active collaborations with 14+ leading organizations including Škoda Auto Volkswagen, Infosys, LIEBHERR, HIKAL, Atlas Copco, NASSCOM, RUCHA ENGINEERING 2.0, CIPET, Innovation Incubation Center, RAJURI STEEL, Bridgewater State University (USA), ISHRAE, MAHAVITARAN, SONY, and NIELIT.

items.question: What specialized laboratories are available at SOET MGM University?
items.answer: SOET houses state-of-the-art facilities including the Industrial Robotics Lab, Electric Vehicle (EV) Lab, Mechatronics & Industry 4.0 Lab, Low-Power High-Speed Chip Design & Cleanrooms, and Innovation Incubation and Research Center (IIRC) & Startup Cell.
